replies.author: IAMPHIL
replies.body:
Oddly for a game so focused on brutality, betrayal, violence, techno-fear and man’s inhumanity to man, generosity is Call of Duty: Black Ops 3’s biggest asset. This is a mountainous all-you-can-eat buffet of a Call of Duty, its steaming heated trays crammed with game modes, options and hidden features. It adds enough to the core gameplay to make it feel like more than just another lazy retread, and it’s easily the best-looking CoD to date. 

The only problem is that, as with all all-you-can-eat buffets, some portions are a lot tastier than others, leaving you wondering whether a little more focus might have created something really exceptional. 

Black Ops 3 is a solid installment that will please the series’ hardcore fans, but it’s not a mainstream crowd-pleaser in the way that last year’s Advanced Warfare was.

In a way, it suffers because of Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. The first Black Ops bought a very distinctive flavour to Call of Duty; one born of conspiracy theory, spy thrillers and darker style of storytelling. The second mixed that up with a sci-fi techno-thriller, splitting the action between interleaved, branching past and near-future storylines and bringing bots and drones into the mix.  Black Ops 3’s focuses entirely on the sci-fi stuff, loses most of its conspiracy theory trappings and brings augmented super-soldiers in. The result sometimes feels less like a third Black Ops game than Call of Duty: Even More Advanced Warfare. It leaves you wondering whether it’s time Call of Duty looked back to the past for inspiration.

replies.author: Zaquez
replies.body:
Ign: My ingame name is Zaquez
Role(s): I like playing Mid and Attacking, If It's about CTW I like attacking and I am pretty good at Capping, If It's CTF I like taking mid control and pushing together with my team. 
Discord: Zaquez #0248
Why should we pick you: You should pick me to play in your team because I am really active and I am down to play at any time. I am really good at melee and I have been involved in a lot of different communites, I used to play OCN back in the day (like 2013) and I had a really great time playing CTW, I recently got back into it when Badlion hosted the tournament, I am really getting back into it and I will be participating in the CTF tournament (Hopefully for Ominous Pink). I have been playing MCSG since 2013 and I am known in that community, being in one of the best clans and reaching the finals of the best tournaments for the SG gamemode. I am really good at rod and melee, I have been getting good with the bow recently aswell. I have also been playing badlion since season4, since season7 actively. 
Do you have any experience: Yes I do, I have been playing the CTW/CTF gamemodes for a very long time, but I wasn't involved in the team community. I am really good at the gamemode and I have a good sense for the game and how to play it.
What are you good at: Like I stated earlier, I am really good at melee and I have a good sense for the game, I can play both mid and attacking, I love attacking though and I am very good at running, using the terrain and placing blocks, and I have been playing as a capper for Team Rift (the team i played ctw with)
How active are you: I am pretty much on all the time, I can come on whenever it's needed, If I'm not with friends or gone, I am almost always available to play.
Why do you want to join us: Because I want to play with some of the biggest names from OCN that I still remember and I am friends with some members in this team, such as Joyful. I just want a good team to play more CTW/CTF tournaments with since I really love the gamemodes.
Any video of you playing: When we did the Badlion CTW Tournament we played against Tylarzz's team while he streamed it and we beat them (I capped) but I can't find the link right now. Other than that I don't have any clips of me playing OCN styled gamemodes, but I have clips of me playing Build/SG/Pot on my channel, I will be uploading some of the highlights from the scrims I've done with Ominous Pink soon though. Here's my channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzOCVw_aFsyVRE2xCJjFzSg?view_as=subscriber
